title: Fractal Audio VP4

x_pc.additionalInfo: PC 0-103 selects VP4 presets A1-Z4. VP4 does not transmit or respond to bank select.

additionalInfo: Incoming MIDI CCs are globally assignable in SETUP > MIDI/Remote to functions including input and output volumes, tap tempo, tuner, four external controllers, additional preset and scene functions, and all block bypass/channel switches. VP4 can transmit PC messages, receives MIDI clock, and does not transmit MIDI clock.
